alpha.description: coefficient controlling incidence of false positives.
constraints: alpha and beta must be in range (0, 1]
if alpha is not provided, it defaults to 0.5

beta.description: coefficient controlling incidence of false negatives.
constraints: alpha and beta must be in range (0, 1]
if beta is not provided, it defaults to 0.5

axis.description: tuple for which dimensions the loss is calculated.

output.description: Tversky loss value. Reference: - [Salehi et al., 2017](https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.05721)

constraints: alpha and beta must be in range (0, 1]
